dataset.name: WTC 1 V8O vector-digitized Floor 98 anisotropic redistribution graph
dataset.scope: Extract relative Floor 98 core-column loads from NIST Figures 4-64 and 4-65, identify an anisotropic cold redistribution kernel on the bubble-map changes, and validate the transferred kernel against the separate Floor 93-99 post-impact DCR map.
dataset.warning: The bubble maps and DCR maps are outputs of the same NIST global model. Cross-figure prediction reduces direct target leakage but remains official-model emulation, not independent validation or a recovered ANSYS input deck.

official_facts.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL
official_facts.fact: Figures 4-64 and 4-65 map axial loads in every WTC 1 core and exterior column at Floor 98 before and immediately after impact; circle size is proportional to the displayed load scale and compression is positive.
official_facts.confidence: high; complete page visually checked and vector paths inspected

official_facts.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL
official_facts.fact: Table 4-20 gives 34,029 kip before impact and 34,429 kip after impact for the total Floor 98 core-column load.

official_facts.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL
official_facts.fact: Figures 4-68 and 4-69 provide the separate maximum axial DCR target over Floors 93-99 used only after the bubble-kernel identification.

vector_digitization.normalization_rule: Loads are proportional to vector radius squared and normalized separately to the published core total; legend-derived absolute values are retained only as a consistency diagnostic.

source_boundary_conditions.damage_release_definition: For kernel identification only, each damaged source release equals its normalized before-map load minus its normalized after-map load; the observed residual load stays on the source.

anisotropic_kernel.formula: weight = capacity^p * exp(-abs(dx)/Lx - abs(dy)/Ly + bx*dx/Lx); the separate +400-kip net gain uses capacity^p * exp(by*y).

nested_spatial_validation.method: three outer row-block folds; candidate kernel selected only on the other two blocks and evaluated on the untouched block
nested_spatial_validation.score_targets: surviving-column normalized after-impact bubble loads; damaged source columns are boundary conditions and excluded from fitting scores
nested_spatial_validation.dcr_usage: No post-impact DCR value participates in kernel selection. The entire 38-column DCR map is a separate cross-figure validation target.

dcr_transfer.floor_total_curve: Reuse the V8N full-fit logistic Floor 93-99 total-load transition without refitting.
dcr_transfer.preimpact_prior: Reuse the V8N pre-impact DCR-times-capacity prior by floor.
dcr_transfer.floor_specific_damage: Use V8B Case B removed segments by floor and redistribute their prior loads with the final V8O anisotropic kernel.
dcr_transfer.official_target: Reuse the V8N transcription of NIST Figure 4-69 only for final validation.

acceptance_gates.physical_interpretation: Passing validates only the transferability of this reduced anisotropic emulator across selected NIST figures. It does not validate the real collapse mechanism.
